key.description: Stable identity: the directory name of the skill (e.g. `citation-cleanup`); used in plans and work items.

name.description: Human-readable name from the document frontmatter.

description.description: One-line description for catalogs and the brain skill-listing tool.

version.description: Semver from `version` frontmatter, or `0.1.0` when absent (task 25.4).

triggerWhen.description: Free-text hints from `trigger_when`, normalised to a list (empty when absent). The brain reads these; the catalog never narrows selection by them (task 25.5).

id.description: SourceRef id, scoped to the kind.

items.description:
One `validate_against` entry shaped like a Context Fabric `SourceRef`:
`kind` (e.g. `knowledge`, `control`) plus the ref id
(e.g. `doc/citation-style@v3`). The catalog never resolves the ref
itself; the brain interprets the kind and id when the skill is selected.

validateAgainstRefs.description: SourceRef-shaped entries from `validate_against` (`{ kind, id }` objects).

description: Catalog-facing skill metadata. The system-prompt body is deliberately not part of it.
